summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss@2.0.5 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses execFileSync to run the shipped sibling math_init.js under that freshly-downloaded runtime. math_init.js is a ~727KB file prefixed '// @bun @bun-cjs' consisting of a large rotated string-array with a shuffle function (WV8StW) — a string-array obfuscator whose runtime behavior is opaque to Node-based inspection. The package name mimics the legitimate rollup-plugin-postcss (published by egoist), which ships no such preinstall hook; this is a scoped lookalike shipping a dropper. Executing an obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime pulled in from a network fetch on `npm install` is attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
